results.description:
The easiest way to plan and discover social events. Create free event invite pages, send text updates, sell tickets, and find the best events near you.

ACTUALLY FUN EVENT PAGES (100% FREE)
- Create pages for any event — birthdays, pregames, dinners, game nights, watch parties, group trips, bachelor/bachelorettes, weddings, and more
- Make it aesthetic with page themes, effects, and event posters—or upload your own
- Guests can see who else is going and add comments, GIFs, and photos to the page

INVITE FRIENDS ON ANY PLATFORM (not just iPhones)
- Customize your RSVP settings for all types of events, public or private
- Invite anyone with a link — guests don't need the app! One link works for both Apple and Non-Apple users, and you can track RSVPs in real time.
- Re-use your guest lists, and invite people you meet at other Partiful parties

SHARE UPDATES AND PHOTOS
- Text Blast your guests with important updates
- Post comments on the page that guests can react and reply to
- Upload pics to a Shared Photo Album, and collect photos from guests

FIND EVENTS & THINGS TO DO NEAR YOU
- Find events happening near you on the Explore page
- Explore community events, live music, art shows, food festivals, local markets, classes, workshops, and more near you.
- Discover social events your friends and mutuals are attending
- RSVP "interested" to save events for later
- Stay in the loop on trending events in your city

HOST PUBLIC EVENTS
- Create public events people can discover, join, and RSVP to
- Reach local audiences and attract new attendees
- Free exposure on a public event marketplace
- Grow a following of repeat guests & community members
- For event hosts, organizers, clubs, groups, nightlife & creators

SELL TICKETS
- Sell tickets and collect payments for any Partiful event
- Add free or paid tickets with multiple tiers, capacity limits, and promo codes
- Guests checkout quickly using Apple Pay, credit, or debit
- Check in guests easily with QR code scanning right from your phone
- Sales, guest list, and payouts tracked in one place
- Direct bank payouts after the event via Stripe

FIND A TIME THAT WORKS FOR EVERYONE
- Not sure who's free? Poll your guests before selecting a final date
- Guests can RSVP to multiple options, and you pick what works best
- Everyone's RSVP is automatically updated once you pick a date

BE TYPE-A ABOUT IT
- Drop your Venmo or CashApp for guests to chip in
- Limit spots available, we'll handle the waitlist
- Add a questionnaire for dietary restrictions, location preferences, and more

OR BE CHILL
- Create a simple page in seconds (literally)
- Leave date & time TBD, figure out details later
- Keep it casual with designs for board game nights, dinners, and date night

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR SOCIAL LIFE
- View events you're planning and attending in one place
- Auto-add all Partiful events to your Google, Apple, or Outlook calendar
- Check the guest lists to see who's coming
- Discover Open Invite events hosted by your Mutuals

ORGANIZER PROFILES
- Showcase all your events with a single shareable link
- Easily re-invite past guests and grow a community that keeps showing up
- Work with co-admins to create and manage events

PARTY PROFILES
- Add a bio, profile photo, and your socials
- Show off how many events you've hosted and attended
- Keep track of your Mutuals (the people you've partied with)

SEND FREE ONLINE GREETING CARDS
- Takes two seconds, looks like you tried
- Create personalized digital greeting cards & ecards with your photos, or choose a fun poster
- Share with one link that works anywhere: text, email, or DMs
- Perfect for birthday, thank you, Christmas, save the date, wedding, love, thinking of you, get well soon cards & more
